title: When the Portrait Burns Revisited
author: Gideon Nystrom
blurb: Isandro Quintana, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
